'''Fogmog''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in the {{2|Overgrowth}}. It summons an {{M2|Eye With Teeth}} at the start of the fight.

== Fogmog ==
{{Enemy Infobox
|Name   = Fogmog
|Image  = StS2_Fogmog.png
|HP     = 74
|AscHP  = 78
|Debut  = Overgrowth
|Type   = Normal
}}

=== Pattern ===
{{Intents Table/start|Fogmog}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Illusory Spores
|Intent = Summon
|Effect = Summons an {{M2|Eye With Teeth}}.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Thwack
|Intent = Attack2, Buff
|Effect = Deals (8;{{Asc2|9|9}}) damage. Gains 1 {{BD2|Strength}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Strength
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Headbutt
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (14;{{Asc2|9|16}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Fogmog always opens with {{Int2|Fogmog|Illusory Spores}} to summon an {{M2|Eye With Teeth}}, then uses {{Int2|Fogmog|Thwack}}.

After that, it randomly picks {{Int2|Fogmog|Thwack}} (40%) or {{Int2|Fogmog|Headbutt}} (60%), and cannot pick the same one twice in a row. After a random {{Int2|Fogmog|Thwack}}, it always follows up with {{Int2|Fogmog|Headbutt}}. After {{Int2|Fogmog|Headbutt}}, it always follows up with {{Int2|Fogmog|Thwack}}, then returns to the random pick.

{{Clear}}

== Eye With Teeth ==
{{Enemy Infobox
|Name   = Eye With Teeth
|Link   = Slay The Spire 2:Fogmog#Eye With Teeth
|Image  = StS2_Eye With Teeth.png
|HP     = 6
|Powers = {{BD2|Illusion}}
|Debut  = Overgrowth
|Type   = Minion
}} 
{{Power Infobox|Illusion|2}}
{{Power Infobox|Minion|2}}
The Eye With Teeth is a minion summoned by Fogmog via {{Int2|Fogmog|Illusory Spores}}.

=== Pattern ===
{{Intents Table/start|Eye With Teeth}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Distract
|Intent = StatusCard
|Effect = Shuffles 3 {{C2|Dazed}} into your discard pile.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Uses {{Int2|Eye With Teeth|Distract}} every turn.


== Trivia ==
* Eye With Teeth is one of only 4 enemies in the game to be incapable of causing damage, the other three being the {{M2|Noisebot}}, {{M2|Guardbot}} and {{M2|Fat Gremlin}}.

{{Clear}}

== Update History ==
{{Update History Table/start}}
{{Update History Table/row|V0.74.0|* Changed Fogmog:
** Damage decreased
** HP increased from 71(73) -> 74(78)
* Reworked Illusions:
** Instead of healing to full HP and becoming stunned, Illusions now revive next turn at full HP, similar to Decimillipede
** No longer keep their debuffs after dying, preventing them from being trivialized by Doom or Poison
** All Illusions are now also Minions
** Thanks to Vex'd for the suggestions!}}
{{Update History Table/row|V0.73.0|* Reworked Illusion monsters like Eye With Teeth and Parafright: no longer have infinite HP, and they no longer have both the Illusion and Disrupt power. Instead, when an Illusion is "killed", it immediately revives to full HP and is stunned.}}
{{Update History Table/row|V0.44.0|* Buffed Fogmog: increased HP}}
{{Update History Table/row|V0.38.0|* Changed Fogmog:
** Swipe move now also grants itself 1 Strength
** Fogmog can now randomly decide to Swipe twice in a row before Headbutting}}
{{Update History Table/row|V0.22.0|* Buffed Fogmog: damage increased from 7/13 -> 9/15}}
{{Update History Table/row|2023-09-15|* Fogmog is now a strong enemy, HP increased from 58 -> 66, and its illusion no longer applies Weak}}
{{Update History Table/row|2023-07-21|* Deprecated normal room encounter that was a combination of Slimes + Fogmog}}
{{Update History Table/row|2023-04-21|* fogmog applying illusion to the wrong target}}
{{Update History Table/row|?|* Added Fogmog to the game}}
{{Update History Table/end}}
